```{=html}
<div id="explore" class="x-app">
  <div class="x-side">
    <input id="x-search" type="search" placeholder="search descriptions, titles, tags" autocomplete="off">
    <div class="x-controls">
      <label>sort
        <select id="x-sort">
          <option value="date-desc">newest first</option>
          <option value="date-asc">oldest first</option>
          <option value="series">by series</option>
          <option value="saturation">most colourful</option>
          <option value="edges">most line</option>
          <option value="busyness">busiest</option>
          <option value="lightness">lightest</option>
        </select>
      </label>
      <button id="x-clear" type="button">clear filters</button>
    </div>
    <div id="x-active" class="x-active"></div>
    <div id="x-facets"></div>
  </div>
  <div class="x-main">
    <div class="x-bar">
      <span id="x-count"></span>
      <span class="x-views">
        <button type="button" data-view="grid" class="is-on">grid</button>
        <button type="button" data-view="map">map</button>
      </span>
    </div>
    <div id="x-grid" class="x-grid"></div>
    <div id="x-map" class="x-map" hidden></div>
  </div>
  <div id="x-detail" class="x-detail" hidden></div>
</div>
<script src="explore/explore.js"></script>
```
